findings.rationale: Verified: scripts/probe-engine-capability.sh:388-489 launches codex, agy, grok, qoderclicn, cursor, kimi and opencode with no child-session helper; only the claude branches (:459-467) call child_session_env_setup. The launch table now routes every probe branch through child_session_env_setup, and case (f) lists every probe runner with a stub, so the helper -u mutation turns them red.
Verified: both author claude branches pass --tools "" (dispatch-author.sh:1270). Row l now uses one hetero cc-shim run, whose child keeps its tools; author production flags unchanged.

Verified: dispatch-foreman.sh:351-357 filters AUTOPILOT_* itself and launches through env -i, so the helper mutation cannot turn the foreman case red. The negative control now expects only helper-dependent scrub cases red and keeps the separate foreman-filter mutation for the foreman case.

Checked on develop with grep -n: ensurePlainMarker is called at hooks/runs-watch-autostart.js:275 (fast path) and :293 (full path); session-mode.js:696 defines it and :742 is the ensure-child call; repo-identity.sh:140 starts child_session_pin and :144 copies _CHILD_SESSION_PIN_UNSET. The cited lines match; the seat estimated positions from the context file instead of counting.

Partly verified. The detached child is not frozen text: dispatch-hetero.sh:4971 writes declare -f child_session_env_setup at detach time, so an edited helper body reaches it. The real gap is the fallback at :3653 (helper absent), which unsets only AUTOPILOT_SESSION_ID. Folded: the mechanism paragraph states declare -f and requires the :3653 fallback to remove C; case (f) adds hetero codex in detached mode; a negative control removes the helper from the :4971 list while the fallback lacks C removal and shows that case red.

Verified: the fast path at runs-watch-autostart.js:275 needs a live watcher, cache and pointer. Case (a) now claims only the full path through the hook, plus the direct ensurePlainMarker writer cases that both call sites share; no watcher staging is attempted.
